pattern.description: Natural handheld camera drift and reframing on a talking-head interview single while the speaker talks; the camera tilts up slightly and the subject settles lower in frame.
pattern.why_premium: Shallow depth of field, warm practical background and a softly moving camera give the founder testimony a candid documentary feel instead of a locked-off corporate interview.

build_hint.gsap: For a live-footage plate: gsap.fromTo('.footage', {y: '-1%', scale: 1.02}, {y: '1%', scale: 1.0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'sine.inOut'}) to simulate a slow handheld tilt/reframe; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: y = interpolate(frame, [0, 26], [-0.01, 0.01] * height, {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin)}) and scale 1.02 -> 1.0 on an <OffthreadVideo> wrapper; add low-amplitude noise for handheld feel.

notes: Camera verdict tilt_up with tiny shifts (pan_y 0.10, scale 0.985); motion is mostly handheld drift plus subject head movement. Labelled slide_down because the content moves down as the camera tilts up. All SFX candidates look like music bed peaks.
